pages.purpose: Orient the owner to recurring bookkeeping and invite a fit-call request.
pages.visitorOutcome: Know what the firm does, what arrives monthly, and how to ask about fit.

sections.question: Is this service for my company?
sections.message: Monthly bookkeeping and tax-ready reporting for small service companies.
sections.composition: Large serif proposition with a compact number/date rail rather than an image placeholder.
sections.emphasisReason: The first decision is whether recurring bookkeeping fits.
sections.mobileTransformation: Offer first, short detail second, action before process rail.
sections.transition: A fine rule connects the offer to the monthly sequence.

sections.question: What actually happens each month?
sections.message: Categorize, reconcile, report, and discuss the numbers.
sections.composition: Three unequal numbered beats on a continuous line with a separate review-call coda.
sections.emphasisReason: This reduces uncertainty without pretending to show client results.
sections.mobileTransformation: Keep beat order and rule continuity in one column.
sections.transition: Tinted process field gives way to plain paper detail.

sections.question: Will this replace my tax preparer?
sections.message: Reports are tax-ready; tax filing, audits, and legal advice are outside scope.
sections.composition: Plain-language boundary in a narrow reading column with an aligned side note.
sections.emphasisReason: Important qualification should be easy to find but not overshadow the offer.
sections.mobileTransformation: Put the boundary directly after the service explanation.
sections.transition: A short rule opens the contact invitation.

sections.question: What happens if I reach out?
sections.message: Request a 20-minute fit call by email; the team replies within two business days to arrange it.

action.label: Request a fit call
action.behavior: Navigate to contact form; submission opens an email draft and does not book a time

sections.composition: Copper action on a dark ink field with short expectation copy.
sections.emphasisReason: A visitor who has assessed the scope now has a clear next step.
sections.transition: End with a separate contact page for the full request.

pages.purpose: Explain exact monthly deliverables, exclusions, and pricing process.
pages.visitorOutcome: Decide whether the documented service scope warrants an inquiry.

sections.question: What will I receive?
sections.message: A repeatable monthly close and reporting conversation.
sections.composition: Compact serif heading beside a numbered month marker.
sections.emphasisReason: The interior answers the detailed service question rather than repeating the homepage hero.
sections.mobileTransformation: Heading precedes marker and scope text.

sections.question: Which tasks are included?
sections.message: Categorization, reconciliation, P&L, balance sheet, and monthly review call.
sections.purpose: Show each included part in a scannable hierarchy.
sections.composition: Four unequal service rows connected by the month line; reports and conversation receive more space than categorization.
sections.emphasisReason: The details are the page's main job.
sections.mobileTransformation: Rows stack with labels before explanation.
sections.transition: A wider blank gap separates inclusions from exclusions.

sections.question: What is outside scope, and how is price set?
sections.message: No tax filing, audits, or legal advice. Pricing follows review of volume and complexity.
sections.purpose: Prevent mistaken expectations and explain why no fixed price appears.
sections.composition: Two contrasting text columns for exclusions and pricing process, then a clear contact action.
sections.emphasisReason: These distinctions affect a purchase decision.
sections.mobileTransformation: Exclusions then pricing, followed by contact action.
sections.transition: Close with expectation of a reply, not a booked appointment.

pages.purpose: Let a visitor compose a fit-call inquiry with accurate next-step expectations.
pages.visitorOutcome: Understand that an email draft is created and a reply follows within two business days.

sections.question: What happens after I reach out?
sections.message: Send an inquiry; the team replies within two business days to arrange a 20-minute fit call.
sections.emphasisReason: The action must be understood before a visitor enters details.

sections.question: What details are needed for an initial inquiry?
sections.message: Name, email, and a short description of the bookkeeping need; no financial details requested.
sections.purpose: Collect enough context for a fit call request without overburdening the visitor.

action.label: Open email draft
action.behavior: Validate fields, then open a pre-addressed email draft; no booking or background submission

sections.composition: Single readable form column with explicit labels and a secondary direct email link.
sections.emphasisReason: The contact task is the page's main job.
sections.interaction: native required-field validation and mailto draft
sections.mobileTransformation: Labels remain above full-width inputs with a large action target.
sections.transition: End with a reminder of response timing.
